summary: Enjoy cute farming games! Customize your farm and create a charming world!
description:
Enjoy a Relaxing Farm Life with Sumikkogurashi!

This game is perfect for those who love farming games, enjoy a relaxing experience, or are fans of Sumikkogurashi. Create your very own farm and garden with the help of the beloved Sumikkogurashi characters. Decorate your farm, grow crops, and enjoy the adorable adventures in a cute, heartwarming world.

Features of the Game

◆ Experience a Relaxing Farm Life
Cultivate crops in your fields and expand your farm and garden. Use the harvested crops to make treats and meals, which can be shipped to earn coins and experience points. Design your dream farm with colorful decorations and cute items. Perfect for fans of kawaii games!

◆ Animal Care and Item Collection
Take care of adorable animal-like characters and collect eggs while developing your farm. Unlock new areas and items as your farm grows, creating a vibrant and lively farming game experience.

◆ Dress Up Your Favorite Characters
Customize Sumikkogurashi characters with the “dress-up” feature. Change their outfits to match the seasons or your mood, adding charm and fun to your cute game.

◆ Create Your Unique Farm
Enjoy the sandbox-style gameplay by decorating your farm and garden to your taste. For those who love gardening, plant flowers and trees to create a beautiful, personalized garden. This game is ideal for players who love farm games and cute games.

◆ Spend Relaxing and Healing Moments
This game provides a stress-free and soothing experience. Escape from the busy day-to-day grind and enjoy slow-paced, fulfilling farm life alongside Sumikkogurashi characters.

Who This Game is For
• Fans of Sumikkogurashi characters
• Lovers of farming games, farm games, and sandbox-style games
• Players who enjoy cute games and kawaii games
• Those looking for a calming, stress-free game experience
• Anyone interested in farm and gardening simulations

Build Your Dream Farm
Grow crops, care for animals, and expand your farm with adorable Sumikkogurashi characters. Create a unique farm and experience the joy of relaxing gameplay that lets you unwind and find comfort.

Please note:
Some paid content is available in the game.
An internet connection is required to play, and data usage fees may apply.

System Requirements
• Android OS 6.0 or later
• 64-bit CPU
